name: home_r1_drive
source: PLAN R2.2 R5 drive route, owner-specified 2026-09-26. Spawn: the owner's point 50.114143 N 8.535170 E on Engelsruhe (Frankfurt-Unterliederbach), snapped 3.2 m onto the centreline of OSM way 5890922. yaw_deg -146.3 is the heading of the first segment (0 = east, counter-clockwise). Route: spawn -> owner waypoint A (50.11709 N 8.531428 E, snapped 1.3 m onto the northbound B 8) -> B 8 north-west past Kelkheim-Hornau, then north past Altenhain and Schneidhain -> end at OSM node 2814410502 (traffic_sign=city_limit 'Koenigstein im Taunus') on Sodener Strasse (B 8/B 519), the southern edge of Koenigstein. Built from OSM road ways in the source store's g2m.src.osm tiles: shortest path over drivable ways, oneway respected, B 8 cost x0.35, OSM centreline nodes densified to <= 5 m. Road sequence by arc length: Engelsruhe 0-31 m, Koenigsteiner Strasse 31-142 m, B 8 trunk 142-6811 m, Hornau trunk_link 6811-7149 m, B 8 primary 7149-9736 m, Sodener Strasse 9736-9855 m. End point chosen from store data: it is the city_limit sign node. Building centroids from the same OSM tiles show nothing within 60 m of the road for the preceding ~700 m of forest; buildings within 50 m of the road appear from s ~9700 m. tools/route_check on the real store: 2103 waypoints, 9854.5 m, 49 seam crossings, no NoData, elevation 108.9-380.4 m, p99 grade 7.79 %, max grade 30.41 %. The three stretches above 12 % are 2-3.5 m deep, 20-40 m long dips in the bare-earth DGM1 under the road: s 2847-2888 m (30.4 %, at the only OSM-tagged bridge, 13 m of B 8), s 4430-4477 m (20.7 %) and s 5239-5283 m (24.4 %). The last two have no bridge tag on the B 8 ways. Outside the three dips the max grade is 7.87 %. Tightest corners (circle through the points +-10 m along the route): 7.3 m at s=31 m (Engelsruhe -> Koenigsteiner Strasse junction), 22.0 m at s=141 m and 24.6 m at s=152 m (turning onto the B 8). criteria: max_grade_pct 31.0 and min_corner_radius_m 7.0, i.e. the measured 30.41 % and 7.3 m plus a small margin. min_length_m and min_seam_crossings keep route_check's defaults (3000 m, 12).
